children: Anavex received FDA clearance to proceed with its IND for blarcamesine in Fragile X syndrome and plans a Phase 2a study.
FDA notified Anavex it may proceed with the IND for ANAVEX®2-73 (blarcamesine) in Fragile X syndrome, opening the IND in the U.S.
An open IND enables advancement of a planned Phase 2a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging study.
Phase 2a will evaluate safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics of oral blarcamesine in ~60 adult males with Fragile X, with behavioral and cognitive secondary endpoints.
Blarcamesine previously received FDA Orphan Drug designation for Fragile X and published preclinical EEG biomarker data supporting translation to humans.
